event_id.description: Created once with the outbox record. Re-publication/retry keeps the same event_id.

occurred_at.description: Actual business-event occurrence time, not RabbitMQ publication time.

sales_channel_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

visitor_id.description: Browser/device profile UUID owned by Next.js. May be absent for direct email/phone.

session_id.description: Frontend session UUID owned by Next.js when known.

cart_id.description: Frontend cart/checkout correlation identifier when known.

lead_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

customer_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

order_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

manual_sale_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

refund_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

aggregate_id.description: Stable Shopware entity UUID serialized as 32 lowercase hex characters.

correlation_id.description: One business-process correlation id, e.g. checkout, when applicable.

contact_id.description: Shopware Contact entity id when the event is related to a confirmed contact.
